correctness.rationale: A complete 2^16-configuration enumeration supplies 261 faces and a 116-pair acyclic Morse matching with precisely one 0-cell, 19 2-cells, and eight 3-cells. The exact signed integral 3-to-2 Morse differential is zero in all eight columns. Consequently the 3-cell attaching maps into a wedge of 19 2-spheres represent zero in pi_2 by Hurewicz, establishing the claimed integral homotopy wedge. The checker also compares full mod-two boundary ranks and Euler characteristic; it is bundled in the package.

value.rationale: The full bidirected five-vertex wheel is the smallest nondegenerate wheel containing overlapping rim and spoke directed cycles, a natural first case beyond the bidirected paths and polygons emphasized in contemporary literature. The exact two-dimensional and three-dimensional sphere wedge is a nontrivial topological classification, not a routine numerical Betti count; its integral null-attachment certificate is essential. It supplies a concrete boundary example motivated by the published Problem 6.3, without alleging a general wheel theorem.
